text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
結局、オルニウスには逃げられちゃったね。
ぼく、くたびれ損でお腹がすいちゃったよ。
text.official_en:
Well, the ornius got away. We got roughed up for
nothing, and now I'm starving.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ

text.jp:
そんなに落ち込まなくても、
そのうちまた迷い込んでくるよ、多分。
text.official_en:
Hey, no need to get so down about it. I bet it'll
wander back this way eventually.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
うん……そうだよね。
試しに、食べ物でも置いといてみようかな……
text.official_en:
You're probably right. Maybe we should try putting
out some bait?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ピーテル

text.jp:
そういえばティアラ、
おじいさんの用事って、大丈夫だったのかな。
text.official_en:
Oh, hey, do you think Tialla managed to run all
those errands for her grandpa yet?
text.real_en:
Oh, hey, do you think Tiara managed to run all
those errands for her grandpa yet?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
よう、カイ！
カストールさんを見なかったか？
text.official_en: Hey, Cai! Have you seen Castor?
text.real_en: Hey, Kai! Have you seen Castor-san?

text.jp:
うちの母親がこの間世話になってさ。
よろしく言っといてくれよ！
text.official_en:
He helped my mother out the other day.
Can you tell him I said thanks?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
行商人から聞いたんだが、数日ほど前に
柄の悪い連中が村の様子を伺ってたらしい。
text.official_en:
A traveling merchant came through. Said a bunch
of ruffians were awful interested in the village.

text.jp:
そいつの気のせいだと思いたいが……
いちおう警戒しておかないとな。
text.official_en:
I'm hoping it was all in the merchant's head. Still, we
oughta stay on alert anyways. Just in case.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
カイ、いつまでも遊んでないで、
そろそろ家に帰るんだよ！
text.official_en:
Cai, you can't stay out playing forever. It's about time
you went home!
text.real_en:
Kai, you can't stay out playing forever. It's about time
you went home!

text.jp:
陽が落ちたらとっとと家に帰って寝る、
それが子供の仕事ってもんだよ！
text.official_en:
When the sun goes down, you head home and
straight to bed, like a good boy is supposed to!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
さっきティアラねえちゃんが慌てて
走ってったけど、ケンカでもしたの？
text.official_en:
I saw Tialla running off looking frantic. You two
didn't have an argument, did ya?
text.real_en:
I saw Tiara running off looking frantic. You two
didn't have an argument, did ya?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
カイ、俺さっき、凄いの見たよ！
なんか立派な格好をした、いかつい人！
text.official_en: Cai, I just saw a super-big guy in some grand armor!
text.real_en: Kai, I just saw a super-big guy in some grand armor!

text.jp:
村の奥のほうに歩いていったけど
あれが騎士ってやつなんだろうな……
text.official_en:
I guess that's what a knight looks like, huh?
I saw him walk farther into the village.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
街にいる親戚からの手紙で、リベル郡の
総督が年貢の割合を重くしそうだって……
text.official_en:
A relative wrote to tell me the viceroy of Liber is
going to raise the annual tax rate.

text.jp:
くそっ、あいつら、
どこまで搾り取るつもりなんだ……
text.official_en:
Damn it, just how much are those guys going to try
and squeeze us for?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
この村で生まれ、この村を盛りたて、
この村で子供をつくり、この村で死んでゆく……
text.official_en:
We're born in this village, work to make it good,
raise children, then die.

text.jp:
儂の親父も、じいさんも、ご先祖様たちも
みんなそうやって生きたんじゃ。
text.official_en:
My father, my grandfather, and all my people before
them lived just like that too.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
広大な大地とどこまでも続く空、
風と土地からもたらされる数々の恵み……
text.official_en:
The many blessings of the soil, the wind, the sky that
goes on forever...

text.jp:
リベイラは決して豊かな村ではないが、
つつましく生きる分には、これで十分さ。
text.official_en:
Ribeira may not be a wealthy village, but there's
enough for us to live a simple life.
